abstract: Maintains statutory environmental permits and digestate contaminant screening records
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees statutory environmental permits and digestate contaminant screening records for municipal bioenergy infrastructure concessions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Groundwater protection surveillance（AQUIF）
information_points.content:
ENV-AQUIF-LJG：The Dry anaerobic plug-flow consortium has a sentinel borehole sampling frequency of 6 samples/year in surrounding peripheral monitoring wells per the hydrogeological surveillance scheme.
ENV-AQUIF-EAU：The Two-phase high-solids mesophilic consortium maintains a sentinel borehole sampling frequency of 8 samples/year across peripheral monitoring wells under the hydrogeological surveillance scheme.
ENV-AQUIF-W1K：Under the hydrogeological surveillance scheme for surrounding peripheral monitoring wells, the Continuous stirred-tank thermophilic consortium maintains a sentinel borehole sampling frequency of 4 samples/year.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory environmental permits and digestate contaminant screening records（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-PERMIT-WTO：The Two-phase high-solids mesophilic consortium holds active bespoke environmental permit coverage according to the Environmental Agency public register for proposed regional biomethane facility site operations, but its digestate heavy metal contamination rate reaches 68 mg/kg in the pilot anaerobic digestion digestate solid fraction.
ENV-PERMIT-T9Q：For the Continuous stirred-tank thermophilic consortium, active bespoke environmental permit coverage is true under the Environmental Agency public register for proposed regional biomethane facility site operations, and its digestate heavy metal contamination rate is 30 mg/kg in the pilot anaerobic digestion digestate solid fraction.
ENV-PERMIT-LNA：Records for the Dry anaerobic plug-flow consortium confirm active bespoke environmental permit coverage in the Environmental Agency public register for proposed regional biomethane facility site operations, with a digestate heavy metal contamination rate of 30 mg/kg across the pilot anaerobic digestion digestate solid fraction.
